metadata.file_name: 218.  Goecke (2026). Being female and being well-situated implies higher performance on creative thinking tests: Evidence across 62 countries from PISA 2022.pdf
metadata.title: Being female and being well-situated implies higher performance on creative thinking tests: Evidence across 62 countries from PISA 2022

design_fields.q1_rationale: Prior extraction indicates Rubin rules used for PISA 2022 creative thinking PVs.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Prior extraction indicates sampling weights applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: Study across 62 countries with proper multilevel/country-level analysis of PISA data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: Cross-country comparison is study design, not external model validation.
design_fields.q1_rationale: Manual full-text review, Goecke et al. (2026), p. 7: regressions estimated for each plausible value and results combined using Rubin’s rules.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Manual full-text review, Goecke et al. (2026), p. 7: weighted regressions use student-level sampling weights and BRR replicate weights with Fay adjustment.
design_fields.q3_rationale: Manual full-text review, Goecke et al. (2026), p. 7: students nested within schools; school random intercept used in imputation and BRR replicate weights used for regression standard errors.
design_fields.q4_rationale: Manual full-text review, Goecke et al. (2026), Methods: no model validation on an external country, cycle, or data set was identified; Q4 applicability needs protocol review.
design_fields.q4b_note: Manual full-text review, Goecke et al. (2026), p. 7: models estimated separately for each of 62 countries and compared through meta-analysis.
